sketches.mechanism: Ownership move semantics: assigning a non-Copy value transfers ownership, and any later use of the old binding is rejected at compile time.
sketches.resonance: What has been given away cannot be touched again by its former name.

sketches.mechanism: The uninhabited type Never has no values, so Optional<Never> can only inhabit the none case in any real execution.
sketches.resonance: A possible presence is declared, but its only livable form is absence.

sketches.mechanism: A constrained subtype performs range checks on assignment and raises Constraint_Error when a value tries to leave its declared bounds.
sketches.resonance: A life defined as exactly itself breaks the moment it tries to become more.
